IVX AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION PROGRAM — START TODAY

OBJECTIVE

For the next phase, the priority is not adding more features.

The priority is transforming IVX into a stable enterprise production platform.

Current engineering assessment

Product vision: 9/10
Feature breadth: 9/10
Architecture potential: 7/10
Current code consistency: 5/10
Production QA reliability: 3/10
Security maturity: 4/10
Mobile stability: 4/10
Deployment traceability: 6/10
Enterprise readiness: 4/10

MISSION

Increase Enterprise Readiness from 4/10 to at least 9/10 through continuous engineering work.

Create autonomous work queues that operate continuously until all critical work is completed.

==================================================
AUTONOMOUS WORKSTREAMS
==================================================

Assign dedicated AI workers:

Worker 1
Authentication & Security

Worker 2
Mobile Stability (Android + iOS)

Worker 3
Backend/API & Database

Worker 4
Chat, Reels & Media

Worker 5
Performance & Scalability

Worker 6
Production QA & Regression

Worker 7
Deployment, CI/CD & Release

Worker 8
Architecture Refactoring & Technical Debt

Each worker must have:

- backlog
- current task
- blocker
- estimated completion
- evidence
- owner approval status

==================================================
REPORT EVERY 2 HOURS
==================================================

Every report must contain:

1. Tasks completed
2. Tasks in progress
3. Tasks blocked
4. Git commits created
5. Files changed
6. Tests passed
7. Tests failed
8. Production deployments
9. Bugs fixed
10. New regressions
11. Security findings
12. Performance improvements
13. Remaining critical issues
14. Next priorities

Do not send narrative-only updates.

==================================================
AUTONOMOUS DASHBOARD
==================================================

Create an Owner Dashboard showing:

- Active AI workers
- Queued jobs
- Running jobs
- Completed jobs
- Failed jobs
- Blocked jobs
- Pull requests
- Git commits
- Deployments
- APK builds
- iOS builds
- Production health
- Database health
- Security status
- QA status
- Module completion
- Enterprise readiness score

Include progress bars and evidence links.

==================================================
VISUAL PROGRESS
==================================================

Provide a screenshot of the Autonomous Dashboard after each major update showing:

- overall completion %
- work by AI worker
- current deployments
- open blockers
- approvals waiting
- critical alerts

==================================================
OWNER APPROVAL
==================================================

Require owner approval only for:

- production schema changes
- destructive database actions
- credential rotation
- DNS changes
- payment changes
- production releases
- rollback

All analysis, testing, code fixes, builds, and development work should proceed autonomously.

==================================================
SUCCESS METRIC
==================================================

Do not measure success by the number of reports.

Measure success by:

- critical bugs eliminated
- production stability
- successful deployments
- verified test coverage
- enterprise readiness score
- evidence-backed completion

Continue until IVX reaches enterprise production quality.
